limitations: GCN4 group = AAV8-Di-C5 is inferred; deposit only names GCN4
Deuterated TMTpro labels produced by two-pass build plus scripted relabel because sdrf-tools build regex lacks D suffix
Dissociation CID for MS2; HCD MS3 quant not encoded
reconcile flags cleavage agent and organism part are false positives; PRIDE disease (leukemia) ignored
Validation: only the known 'study sample not in pride' cache error; free-text treatment/strain warnings
RAW headers not checked; PD_output.zip msf not fully read

D_ channels annotated as technical replicate 2 of the index-matched non-D source (D_<group> n with <group> n); paper states two technical replicates with deuterated or non-deuterated labels; pairing by index not traced per channel; PRIDE protocol text says instead that one sample carried both label types (unresolved, paper followed)
developmental stage not available; sampling time omitted: paper gives 73-74 days after injection (methods) and 84-85 days post-SNI (results), both ranges
strain or breed not available: paper lists C57BL/6NRj, C57BL/6JRj, C57BL/6JBomTac and writes c57BL6/J for this cohort
Cleavage: paper digests with Trypsin and Lys-C; comment[cleavage agent details] is single-valued so only Trypsin is recorded
PRIDE structured disease (leukemia) overridden by neuropathic pain; contralateral DRGs also labelled neuropathic pain (all mice SNI)
comment[label] accessions taken from the vocabulary used in sibling annotation PXD073925
Laterality only as factor value[laterality]; no characteristics column in the templates
Strain left not available although the paper's TMT methods write 'c57BL6/J' for these mice; Methods list several WT substrains
